intro: One playthrough, no mission replay and no New Game+, so play the story in order and pick up each side line when it opens. Only Positive Mental Attitude can truly be lost (Chapter 1). After the credits free roam stays open for everything else.

stages.title: Chapter 1: Gone Fishing to Paradise Lost
stages.summary: Opening chapter. The one true missable lives here.
tips: After Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate: Chapter 1 only.
Cal’s fishing line opens after Feng Shui; Kenton’s wreck dives start too.
Keep a manual save from the end of Chapter 1.

stages.title: Chapter 2: the side lines open
stages.summary: Partner switching after Coffee Break, garages after Daily Driver, Scooter Bros after Moses.
tips: Start Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub) and Bret’s hunting as soon as Coffee Break is done.
Buy the cheap garages early for parking.

stages.title: Chapter 3: heist tools & strangers
stages.summary: Snap Gun (Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs) and Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check) unlock the robbery trophies.
tips: Finish Race Against Yago before moving on: flagged time-sensitive.
Do every stranger strand in the chapter it appears.

stages.title: Chapters 4–5: finish the story
stages.summary: Main missions to the finale. Take That’s Where The Money Is... at the end of Chapter 4 for the vaults.
tips: A vault job gives 4 stars at once: bring your partner for Hot Together.

stages.title: Free roam: activities & collectibles
stages.summary: Overshoot each count so the 100% checklist fills at the same time.
tips: 300 stunts, 30 race wins, 15 card sets: the 100% targets, not the trophy ones.
Clear the map fog by plane while scanning WAiNK spots.

stages.title: Free roam: the secret trophies
stages.summary: Hidden one-offs. Five have no confirmed method yet; we say so on each.
tips: Airliner from gate E3/E4 at VCIA; Rhino from Mile Zero Air Station.

stages.title: 100% and the platinum
stages.summary: Check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and mop up.
tips: Challenges: 70 of 80 for 100%, so skip the ten hardest.

method: Every trophy name, description and grade is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it (the official list, as PSNProfiles shows it). Hidden flags follow the TrueTrophies list article.

Every guide is written for this app in our own words. Each one cites the pages its facts come from, listed beside the guide; we only cite pages we actually opened. Where no guide covers a trophy yet, the guide says so and cites the PSNProfiles listing, and anything we inferred from the official description is labelled as such.
Missable flags come from the guides’ own missable calls plus the official descriptions’ chapter and mission names. The roadmap orders trophies by the chapter in which each one first becomes possible.
Your progress, counters and spoiler setting are saved in this browser (localStorage). Export writes them to a .json file; Import reads that file back on any device.
